name: Online Compass
description: Find true north instantly with a live browser compass that reads your phone's magnetometer — free, no app, works offline.
longDescription: A real compass in your browser. It reads the device magnetometer and orientation sensors directly and shows your heading the moment the page loads, with true-north correction, four calibration methods and a sunlight-readable dial.
pricingDetails: Completely free. No account, no app, no ads.
features: Live heading 0°–359° from the device magnetometer
True north and magnetic north switch
useCases: Finding north while hiking without a physical compass
Orienting a paper map to the terrain
Checking the direction of a room or building
